atoms.title: The Saxophone
atoms.b: The saxophone is a wind instrument made of brass. It is usually held using a neck strap, so that you do not need your hands to hold the instrument.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-saxophone-1</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> The saxophone is a wind instrument made of brass. It is usually held using a neck strap, so that you do not need your hands to hold the instrument.

atoms.b: The saxophone consists of a mouthpiece, a bow, and ends in a bell. The saxophone is narrowest at the mouthpiece and gets broader to the end.

instruction.text: What does the saxophone look like?
instruction.sound: What does the saxophone look like?

atoms.b: The saxophone has many keys. The upper keys are played with the left hand, and the lower keys are played with the right hand. The more keys are closed, the lower the note that is played.

There are different sized saxophones. Smaller saxophones play higher notes, and larger saxophones can play lower notes. While larger instruments require more air to play, smaller ones need a lot of pressure when blown into.
